# Release Notes

## Database & Storage
- #3148: Proves SQLite/Postgres parity for usage and metering summaries.
- #3521: Runs availability proof on isolated Postgres.
- #3293: Stores finish_reason and truncated in delegation_events.

## Ledger & Workflows
- #1761: Adds work-ledger md renderer and check/repair commands.
- #3207: Adds typed work-ledger bus events and projections.
- #3773: Adds ledger reconciliation compute, effect, and orchestrator nodes.

## Gate & Validation
- #1460: Detects sqlite3 submodule imports in arch-no-raw-sqlite3.
- #1902: Adds node-boundary import gate and baseline.
- #1291: Implements bypass-token blocklist enforcement.
- #1366: Exempts dependency-bot authors from receipt-gate.
- #1654: Closes environment reader inventory residuals.
- #1228: Adds single transport-envelope unwrap predicate.
- #1230: Rejects typing.Protocol handler targets in resolver.
- #990: Implements extract_identifiers and resolve_file_targets.

## Contracts & Models
- #1120: Releases omnibase_core v0.42.0.
- #1559: Adds proof_class field to ModelTicketContract.
- #1049: Adds batch_validator and ModelBatchValidationSummary.
- #1942: Moves boundary-parity and migration-conflicts to omnibase_core.
- #1411: Implements priority/guard-fallthrough in FSM engine.
- #1323: Removes SEA harness fixture prompt-echo stub.

## Protocols & SPI
- #44: Adds projection protocols for orchestrator state.
- #54: Adds ProtocolEventProjector and ProtocolProjectorLoader.

## CI & Infrastructure
- #113: Bumps actions/setup-python from 5 to 6.
- #3468: Fixes action-pin characterization to ignore line numbers.
- #3560: Surfaces invalid label alongside quality gate mismatch.
- #3476: Fixes leading reasoning trace detection for unclosed tags.

## Orchestration & Dispatch
- #3296: Exposes handle entrypoints for AB-compare and dispatch.
- #3811: Fixes PR handoff ingress to read only declared fields.
- #3754: Removes lab defaults from omnimarket readers.
- #3599: Pins omnidash v1.1.7 bundle.
